answer: A glacier creeps each epoch carrying twelve stations, and each identity must cross them before acting; a seal expires once its station slides past the reach window, so proofs cannot be banked. One leg crosses a dune field whose passable line the epoch beacon redraws. At each station a mirror returns the traveler's last seal transformed by the station's secret; the next accepts only the correctly transformed value, so seals cannot be lent or replayed. One honest agent crosses once per epoch. A farm's 1,000 identities need 12,000 in-window crossings, each chained to its own mirror sequence.
